# Linework UI: full reference

> A UI kit in the style of technical drawings: 51 CSS components, 8 custom elements, 25 copy-paste blocks, 3 themes and typed React wrappers. Plain HTML, CSS and light-DOM Web Components with no runtime dependencies and no build step.

Package: `linework-ui`. Files in `dist/`: `linework.css` (all components), `linework-blocks.css` (block layouts only), `linework.global.js` (script tag, exposes `window.Linework`), `linework.js` (ES module), `react.js` (React wrappers), `tokens.css` (custom properties only), `fonts/` (Barlow Semi Condensed, SIL OFL).

This file is generated from the sources by `npm run build`. It holds every component example, every class, every token, the complete type definitions and every block.

## Rules

- Every class starts with `lw-`. Elements use `__` (`lw-field__label`), variants use `--` (`lw-btn--primary`). Block layouts use `blk-*` and need `linework-blocks.css`.
- Buttons: `lw-btn`, plus `--primary`, `--quiet`, `--danger`, `--sm`, `--lg` or `--icon`. Use one `--primary` per view. An icon-only button needs `aria-label`.
- Icons are an inline SVG sprite installed by the script: `<svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-NAME"></use></svg>`. Names: arrow-right, arrow-up-right, blocks, check, chevron-down, chevron-left, chevron-right, clock, close, copy, download, external, file, folder, grid, headphones, info, keyboard, link, menu, minus, mic, more, play, plus, search, settings, sheet, stop, theme, trash, volume, warning.
- Class-based components render without the script. `lw-pad`, `lw-meter`, `lw-command`, `lw-calendar` and `lw-drawer` render nothing until the script runs.
- Custom elements use the light DOM, so page CSS applies inside them. Do not add a shadow root or move their children.
- Red (`--lw-redline`) marks live, playing, destructive or focused state only. Do not use it for decoration.
- Theme with `data-theme="trace|blueprint|vellum"` on `<html>` or any container. Override tokens (`--lw-paper`, `--lw-ink`, `--lw-redline`, `--lw-font-ui`, `--lw-space-8`, ...) instead of writing new colours.
- After inserting markup dynamically, call `Linework.refresh(root)` so sortable tables, steppers and range fills are enhanced.

## Guide

A UI kit in the style of technical drawings: 51 components, 25 copy-paste blocks and three themes. Plain CSS and Web Components with no runtime dependencies and no build step, plus typed React wrappers.

**[Docs](https://jiffies64.github.io/linework-ui/docs/docs.html)** · [Components](https://jiffies64.github.io/linework-ui/docs/components.html) · [Blocks](https://jiffies64.github.io/linework-ui/docs/blocks.html) · [Example console](https://jiffies64.github.io/linework-ui/docs/console.html) · [llms.txt](https://jiffies64.github.io/linework-ui/llms.txt) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/linework-ui)




Linework uses the visual language of architectural drawings: trace paper, a 24 px grid, hairline rules, dimension lines and title blocks. It ships as a CSS library, eight Web Components, 25 composed blocks, React wrappers and a documentation site built from the library itself.

### What is inside

| Piece | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| **CSS** | `linework.css`: tokens, base, layout, 51 components and utilities. 13.6 kB gzipped (minified). |
| **Blocks CSS** | `linework-blocks.css`: layout for the 25 blocks. 5.5 kB gzipped (minified). |
| **Behaviour** | `linework.js`: eight Web Components, icons, menus, toasts, themes, sorting and copy buttons. 16.5 kB gzipped. |
| **React** | `linework-ui/react`: typed wrappers for seven elements, with event props and refs. 1.7 kB gzipped. |
| **Themes** | Trace (light, default), Blueprint (dark) and Vellum (warm), defined entirely in tokens. |
| **Blocks** | Marketing: hero, header, logos, stats, process, features, comparison, pricing, team, testimonial, journal, changelog, FAQ, contact, newsletter, call to action and footer. Application: dashboard, onboarding, billing, members, review inbox, sign in, settings and not found. |
| **Components** | Forms: buttons, button groups, inputs, textareas, selects, search fields, fieldsets, checkboxes, radios, switches, ranges, segmented controls, steppers, combobox and calendar. Instruments: pads, dimension lines, keycaps, lamps, stamps, meters, progress bars, spinners and skeletons. Navigation: tabs, breadcrumbs, pagination, side navigation, steps and trees. Data: tables with sorting, spec lists, stats, activity feeds, setting rows, avatars, chips, file lists and code blocks. Overlays: menus, tooltips, dialogs, sheets, toasts and the command palette. Feedback: empty states, callouts, banners, accordions and dropzones. Plus 33 icons. |
| **Icons** | 33 icons in one inline SVG sprite. |
| **Fonts** | Barlow Semi Condensed, five latin woff2 weights under the SIL Open Font License, used only where Bahnschrift and DIN Alternate are missing. |
| **Pages** | Landing page, block gallery, component gallery, guide, an example project console and block previews. |

Windows uses Bahnschrift and macOS uses DIN Alternate. Every other platform downloads the bundled Barlow from `dist/fonts/`, next to the stylesheet. Nothing is loaded from a CDN.

### Quick start

Install the package, or copy `dist/` into your project and link the files:

```sh
npm install linework-ui
```

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="linework.css">
<script src="linework.global.js" defer></script>

<button class="lw-btn lw-btn--primary">New sheet</button>
<lw-pad name="Publish" keys="1" length="1.2 s"></lw-pad>
```

The script is optional for the class-based components, which render with HTML and CSS alone. The eight custom elements build their markup in the script: without it, `lw-pad`, `lw-meter`, `lw-command`, `lw-calendar` and `lw-drawer` render nothing, and `lw-tabs` and `lw-combobox` show their static children. The script also adds behaviour for menus, toasts, sorting, dismissing, steppers, theme switching and copy buttons. The global build exposes `window.Linework`. The ES module build, `linework.js`, is for bundlers:

```js
import 'linework-ui/style.css';
import Linework from 'linework-ui';
```

When you copy files by hand, keep `dist/fonts/` next to `linework.css`.

#### React

```jsx
import 'linework-ui/style.css';
import { Drawer, Pad } from 'linework-ui/react';

export function Publish({ open, setOpen, run }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Pad name="Publish" keys="1" onPress={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); run(event.detail.pad); }} />
      <Drawer open={open} label="Publish" onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
        <p>Ready to send revision 04.</p>
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}
```

`Drawer`, `Tabs`, `Pad`, `Meter`, `Combobox`, `Command` and `Calendar` take typed event props (`onPress`, `onChange`, `onSelect` and so on) whose `detail` is typed, forward refs to the element, and map booleans to attributes. React and React DOM 18 or later are optional peer dependencies.

#### Blocks

Blocks need the block stylesheet as well:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="linework.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="linework-blocks.css">
<script src="linework.global.js" defer></script>
```

Copy a block's markup from the gallery or from `docs/assets/js/blocks-data.js`. Blocks use `blk-*` layout classes; everything else is the component API.

### Run the site

Requires Node 18 or later. There are no npm packages to install.

```sh
npm start         # static server at http://127.0.0.1:4173/docs/
npm run build     # build dist/ and report gzip sizes
npm run capture   # screenshots for the README and gallery cards
```

The capture script drives Microsoft Edge through the Chrome DevTools Protocol. On macOS or Linux, set `LW_BROWSER` to a Chromium binary.

Pages after `npm start`:

- `/docs/`: landing page
- `/docs/blocks.html`: 25 blocks with live previews, copy and filters
- `/docs/components.html`: component gallery and tokens
- `/docs/docs.html`: guide covering install, tokens, themes, components, API, frameworks and accessibility
- `/docs/console.html`: example project console
- `/docs/preview.html?block=hero`: a single block

### Themes

All three themes set the same custom properties. Apply one to the root or to any container:

```html
<html data-theme="blueprint">
  ...
</html>

<section data-theme="vellum">
  ...
</section>
```

```js
Linework.setTheme('blueprint'); // saved to localStorage
Linework.getTheme();            // 'blueprint'
Linework.cycleTheme();          // next theme
```

Token groups:

- Surfaces: `--lw-paper`, `--lw-paper-lit`, `--lw-paper-deep`
- Ink: `--lw-ink`, `--lw-pencil`, `--lw-faint`
- Structure: `--lw-rule`, `--lw-line`, `--lw-grid`, `--lw-border`, `--lw-border-quiet`
- Signal: `--lw-redline`, `--lw-redline-deep`, used only for live, playing, destructive or focused states
- Type: `--lw-font-ui`, `--lw-font-display`, `--lw-font-narrow`, `--lw-font-mono`
- Space: `--lw-space-*`, named in pixels (`--lw-space-8` is 8 px)
- Motion: `--lw-duration-1` to `--lw-duration-5`, `--lw-ease`

A custom theme can be a few lines. Overrides on `:root` apply under every theme, including Blueprint; to change one theme only, scope them to `[data-theme="trace"]` or a theme name of your own.

```css
:root {
  --lw-paper: #f4f1e8;
  --lw-ink: #1e1c18;
  --lw-redline: #c93027;
  --lw-font-ui: "Barlow Semi Condensed", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
```

### Web Components

The elements render in the light DOM, so your CSS applies inside them.

| Element | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `<lw-drawer>` | Side sheet on a native `<dialog>`, with focus trapping, Escape, backdrop and close control. |
| `<lw-tabs>` | Tabs with roving tabindex, arrow keys, Home/End and panels. |
| `<lw-pad>` | Action pad with progress, countdown, hatch and an optional menu key; `menu="id"` opens that `.lw-menu`. |
| `<lw-meter>` | ARIA meter drawn as a row of ticks, with an optional demo animation. |
| `<lw-combobox>` | Input with a filtered `.lw-listbox`, keyboard navigation and `aria-activedescendant`. |
| `<lw-command>` | Command palette in a native dialog, built from `.lw-command__item` children, with an optional Ctrl/Cmd shortcut. |
| `<lw-calendar>` | Month of day buttons with arrow, Home/End and Page Up/Down keys, `min`, `max` and `locale`. |
| `<lw-toast-stack>` | Popover live region used by `Linework.toast()`. |

```html
<button class="lw-btn" data-lw-open="add-sheet">New sheet</button>

<lw-drawer id="add-sheet" label="New sheet" width="460">
  <div class="lw-drawer__head"><h2 class="lw-drawer__title">New sheet</h2></div>
  <div class="lw-drawer__body">...</div>
  <div class="lw-drawer__foot">
    <button class="lw-btn lw-btn--primary" data-lw-close>Done</button>
  </div>
</lw-drawer>
```

The pad's `lw-press` event is cancelable. Call `preventDefault()` to drive the pad from a real operation; otherwise it runs its own timer.

### JavaScript API

```js
Linework.toast({
  title: 'Added',
  message: 'North facade is now on the schedule.',
  tone: 'success',
});

Linework.open('#new-sheet');
Linework.copy('...');
Linework.refresh(); // repaint range fills after dynamic content
```

Data attributes:

- `data-lw-open`: open a drawer or native dialog
- `data-lw-close`: close the nearest dialog or drawer
- `data-lw-theme`: set a theme, or `cycle`
- `data-lw-menu`: open a positioned menu
- `data-lw-copy` / `data-lw-copy-target`: copy a literal or an element's text
- `data-lw-tip`: supplementary CSS tooltip
- `data-lw-sort`: sortable table headers with `aria-sort`
- `data-lw-dismiss`: remove a chip, banner or file row and keep focus nearby
- `data-lw-step`: step the number input inside `.lw-stepper`

### Accessibility

Linework targets WCAG AA in all three themes:

- Native buttons, inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios and `<details>`.
- Visible dashed focus outlines with offset.
- Native modal dialogs for focus trapping and Escape.
- Keyboard support in tabs, menus and drawers, with no keyboard traps.
- Toasts in a polite live region that pauses on hover and focus.
- Reduced-motion support.
- AA contrast for body text, labels and secondary text, and 3:1 for control borders.

In your own pages, label every control, keep focus visible, do not use redline as the only signal, and test your content at 200% zoom.

### Project structure

```
src/css/        tokens, base, layout, components, blocks
src/js/         linework.js, the behaviour build
src/react/      React wrappers and their types
src/fonts/      bundled Barlow Semi Condensed and its licence
src/types/      TypeScript declarations
scripts/        build, static server and screenshots
dist/           built CSS, JS and types
docs/           site, blocks, components, guide and console example
docs/assets/    site CSS and JS, screenshots and block images
```

The brand names in the blocks ("Fold", "Atelier North") are fictional. Barlow Semi Condensed is by the Barlow Project Authors and is bundled under the SIL Open Font License (`dist/fonts/OFL.txt`). No other third-party assets are bundled.

## Components

Each example below is the live markup from the component gallery, `docs/components.html`.

### Foundations

Paper, ink and redline. Every value is a custom property. Override the values to change the system.

### Icons

Thirty-three drafting icons, one weight, square caps. They are supplementary: always pair an icon with a visible label or an aria-label.

#### Icon set (`.lw-icon`)

Use <svg class="lw-icon"><use href="#lw-i-search"></use></svg>. The sprite is installed by linework.js.

### Keys

Hovering thickens the bottom wall, as if the key stood proud of the sheet. Pressing puts it back flush. Sharp corners, always.

#### Variants (`.lw-btn`)

Primary is for the one next action. Danger is for deleting, stopping or leaving. Redline never decorates.

```html
<button type="button" class="lw-btn">Default</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--primary">Primary</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--danger">Danger</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--quiet">Quiet</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--danger-quiet">Quiet danger</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--link">Text link</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn" disabled>Disabled</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn is-loading">Working</button>
```

#### Sizes & icons (`--sm · --lg · --icon`)

```html
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--sm">Small</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn">Default</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--lg">Large</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--icon" aria-label="Settings"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-settings"></use></svg></button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--icon lw-btn--sm" aria-label="Copy"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-copy"></use></svg></button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-plus"></use></svg>New sheet</button>
```

#### Groups & legends (`.lw-btn-group`)

```html
<div class="lw-btn-group">
  <button type="button" class="lw-btn">Day</button>
  <button type="button" class="lw-btn">Week</button>
  <button type="button" class="lw-btn">Month</button>
</div>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--danger lw-btn--block">Stop all<span class="lw-btn__legend">Ctrl + Alt + Backspace</span></button>
```

### Fields

Native inputs, drawn as boxes. Focus shows a dashed construction line outside the border; invalid fields borrow the redline.

#### Text, search, select (`.lw-input · .lw-search`)

```html
<div class="lw-field">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-name">Project name</label>
  <input class="lw-input" id="c-name" type="text" value="North facade">
  <span class="lw-field__hint">Shown on the schedule and in search.</span>
</div>
<div class="lw-field">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-search">Search sheets</label>
  <div class="lw-search">
    <svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-search"></use></svg>
    <input class="lw-input" id="c-search" type="search" placeholder="Search 6 sheets">
    <span class="lw-keycap lw-search__hint">/</span>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="lw-field">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-device">Default paper</label>
  <div class="lw-select-wrap">
    <select class="lw-select" id="c-device">
      <option>Trace — default</option>
      <option>Blueprint — dark</option>
      <option>Vellum — warm</option>
    </select>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="lw-field">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-note">Note for the next reviewer</label>
  <textarea class="lw-textarea" id="c-note" placeholder="What still needs a decision?"></textarea>
</div>
```

#### States & actions (`aria-invalid · :disabled`)

```html
<div class="lw-field">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-error">Shortcut</label>
  <input class="lw-input" id="c-error" type="text" value="Ctrl+1" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="c-error-note">
  <span class="lw-field__error" id="c-error-note">Another app already uses this combination.</span>
</div>
<div class="lw-field">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-disabled">Workspace</label>
  <input class="lw-input" id="c-disabled" type="text" value="Atelier North" disabled>
  <span class="lw-field__hint">Owner-managed; ask an owner to change it.</span>
</div>
<div class="lw-field">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-output">Workspace path</label>
  <div class="lw-input-row">
    <input class="lw-input" id="c-output" type="text" value="Atelier North / Studio / Sheets" readonly>
    <button type="button" class="lw-btn" data-lw-copy-target="#c-output"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-copy"></use></svg><span class="lw-copy-label">Copy</span></button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="lw-field">
  <div class="lw-field__meta"><label class="lw-field__label" for="c-bio">Short note</label><span>24 / 80</span></div>
  <textarea class="lw-textarea" id="c-bio" rows="3" style="min-height:70px">Measure twice. Comment once.</textarea>
</div>
```

### Choices

An LED square instead of a pill switch. Checkboxes and radios stay native underneath, so keyboard and screen readers behave.

#### On / off & selection (`.lw-led · .lw-check`)

```html
<label class="lw-led lw-led--redline">
  <input class="lw-led__input" type="checkbox" checked>
  <span class="lw-led__box"><span class="lw-led__fill"></span></span>
  <span>Snap to grid</span><span class="lw-led__state">On</span>
</label>
<label class="lw-led">
  <input class="lw-led__input" type="checkbox">
  <span class="lw-led__box"><span class="lw-led__fill"></span></span>
  <span>Guides</span><span class="lw-led__state">Off</span>
</label>
<hr class="demo-divider">
<label class="lw-check"><input class="lw-check__input" type="checkbox" checked><span class="lw-check__box"></span><span>Show rulers on the sheet</span></label>
<label class="lw-check"><input class="lw-check__input" type="checkbox"><span class="lw-check__box"></span><span>Open the overview on start</span></label>
<hr class="demo-divider">
<div class="lw-choices">
  <label class="lw-radio"><input class="lw-radio__input" type="radio" name="c-paper" checked><span class="lw-radio__box"></span><span>Trace</span></label>
  <label class="lw-radio"><input class="lw-radio__input" type="radio" name="c-paper"><span class="lw-radio__box"></span><span>Blueprint</span></label>
  <label class="lw-radio"><input class="lw-radio__input" type="radio" name="c-paper"><span class="lw-radio__box"></span><span>Vellum</span></label>
</div>
```

#### Ranges & segments (`.lw-range · .lw-segments`)

```html
<div class="lw-field">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-volume">Grid opacity</label>
  <input class="lw-range" id="c-volume" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.64">
  <div class="lw-scale"><span>0</span><span>50</span><span>100</span></div>
</div>
<div class="lw-field">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-monitor">Line weight</label>
  <input class="lw-range" id="c-monitor" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.3">
</div>
<hr class="demo-divider">
<div>
  <p class="lw-label" style="margin-bottom:8px">Density</p>
  <div class="lw-segments" role="group" aria-label="Density">
    <button type="button" class="lw-segments__item" aria-pressed="false">Compact</button>
    <button type="button" class="lw-segments__item" aria-pressed="true">Default</button>
    <button type="button" class="lw-segments__item" aria-pressed="false">Room</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div>
  <p class="lw-label" style="margin-bottom:8px">Paper</p>
  <div class="lw-segments lw-segments--block" role="group" aria-label="Paper">
    <button type="button" class="lw-segments__item" aria-pressed="true">Trace</button>
    <button type="button" class="lw-segments__item" aria-pressed="false">Blueprint</button>
    <button type="button" class="lw-segments__item" aria-pressed="false">Vellum</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Pads & dimensions

A pad drawn as a room in plan. While it runs, the walls and dimension turn red and section hatching sweeps the elapsed part. Every pad is a real button.

#### The board (`lw-pad`)

Attributes: name, keys, length, duration, playing, progress, menu. Events: lw-press, lw-play, lw-stop, lw-end. The keycap is a visual legend; shortcuts belong to the application. The pad is a visual timer only; wire it to your own task.

```html
<div class="lw-pads">
  <lw-pad name="Publish" keys="1" length="1.2 s" duration="1.2" menu="c-menu"></lw-pad>
  <lw-pad name="Archive" keys="2" length="0.8 s" duration="0.8"></lw-pad>
  <lw-pad name="Sync" keys="3" length="2.4 s" duration="2.4"></lw-pad>
  <lw-pad name="Send for review" keys="4" length="1.6 s" duration="1.6"></lw-pad>
</div>
```

#### Dimension lines (`.lw-dimension`)

```html
<div class="lw-dimension" role="img" aria-label="Length 3.1 seconds">
  <span class="lw-dimension__cap" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="lw-dimension__rule" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="lw-dimension__label">3.1 s</span><span class="lw-dimension__rule" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="lw-dimension__cap lw-dimension__cap--end" aria-hidden="true"></span>
</div>
<div class="lw-dimension lw-dimension--live" role="img" aria-label="Remaining 2.2 seconds">
  <span class="lw-dimension__cap" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="lw-dimension__rule" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="lw-dimension__label">2.2 s</span><span class="lw-dimension__rule" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="lw-dimension__cap lw-dimension__cap--end" aria-hidden="true"></span>
</div>
<div class="lw-dimension lw-dimension--ink" role="img" aria-label="Width 1440 pixels">
  <span class="lw-dimension__cap" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="lw-dimension__rule" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="lw-dimension__label">1440 px</span><span class="lw-dimension__rule" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="lw-dimension__cap lw-dimension__cap--end" aria-hidden="true"></span>
</div>
```

#### Keys & keycaps (`.lw-keycap`)

```html
<span class="lw-keycap">Ctrl+1</span>
<span class="lw-keycap lw-keycap--ink">Cmd K</span>
<span class="lw-keycap lw-keycap--red">Esc</span>
<span class="lw-keycap lw-keycap--filled">F5</span>
<span class="lw-keycap lw-keycap--lg">Space</span>
<span class="lw-keys"><span class="lw-keycap">Ctrl</span>+<span class="lw-keycap">Alt</span>+<span class="lw-keycap">Backspace</span></span>
```

### Status & data

Lamps, stamps, meters and progress. Redline appears only when something is live, pending or at risk; everything else is graphite.

#### Lamps & stamps (`.lw-lamp · .lw-stamp`)

```html
<div class="lw-cluster">
  <span class="lw-lamp is-on"><span class="lw-lamp__dot"></span>On air</span>
  <span class="lw-lamp"><span class="lw-lamp__dot"></span>Standby</span>
</div>
<div class="lw-cluster">
  <span class="lw-stamp">Draft</span>
  <span class="lw-stamp lw-stamp--red">Live</span>

</div>

  <span class="lw-avatars">
    <span class="lw-avatar">MW</span>
    <span class="lw-avatar">JK</span>
    <span class="lw-avatar">AS</span>
    <span class="lw-avatars__more">+4</span>
  </span>
  <span class="lw-smallprint">Atelier North</span>
</div>
```

```html
<div class="lw-row">

</div>
<div>

```

### Navigation

Tabs are arrow-key navigable; breadcrumbs and pagination keep the page addressable.

#### Tabs (`lw-tabs`)

```html
<lw-tabs style="width:100%">
  <div class="lw-tablist">
    <button class="lw-tab"><span class="lw-tab__num">01</span>Overview</button>
    <button class="lw-tab"><span class="lw-tab__num">02</span>Components</button>
    <button class="lw-tab"><span class="lw-tab__num">03</span>Tokens</button>
  </div>
  <div class="lw-tabpanel"><p class="lw-note">Fifty-one parts on one sheet. Everything here is live: press, type, drag, open a sheet.</p></div>
  <div class="lw-tabpanel"><p class="lw-note">Keys, fields, pads, tables and sheets. Behaviour comes from eight small Web Components.</p></div>
  <div class="lw-tabpanel"><p class="lw-note">Every colour, space and duration is a custom property. Override the values; the rules stay true.</p></div>
</lw-tabs>
```

#### Breadcrumb & pagination (`.lw-breadcrumb · .lw-pagination`)

```html
<nav class="lw-breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb example">
  <ol><li><a href="#">Atelier North</a></li><li><a href="#">Sheets</a></li><li aria-current="page">North facade</li></ol>
</nav>
<nav class="lw-pagination" aria-label="Pagination example">
  <button type="button" aria-label="Previous page"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-chevron-right" style="transform:rotate(180deg)"></use></svg></button>
  <button type="button" aria-current="page">1</button>
  <button type="button">2</button>
  <button type="button">3</button>
  <span class="lw-pagination__gap" style="display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:34px;color:var(--lw-faint)">…</span>
  <button type="button">12</button>
  <button type="button" aria-label="Next page"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-chevron-right"></use></svg></button>
</nav>
```

#### Side navigation (`.lw-sidenav`)

```html
<nav class="lw-sidenav" aria-label="Side navigation example" style="padding:8px 0">
  <p class="lw-sidenav__label">Workspace</p>
  <a class="lw-sidenav__item" href="#"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-grid"></use></svg>Overview</a>
  <a class="lw-sidenav__item" href="#"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-sheet"></use></svg>Sheets<span class="lw-sidenav__count">284</span></a>
  <a class="lw-sidenav__item" href="#" aria-current="page"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-check"></use></svg>Reviews<span class="lw-sidenav__count">04</span></a>
</nav>
```

### Overlays

Sheets and dialogs are native <dialog> elements: top layer, focus trapped, Escape and backdrop for free. Toasts use popovers so they stay above them.

#### Sheets & dialogs (`lw-drawer · .lw-dialog`)

The drawer is a side sheet; the dialog is centred. Both close with Escape or the visible close control.

```html
<button type="button" class="lw-btn" data-lw-open="c-drawer"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-sheet"></use></svg>Open a sheet</button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--danger-quiet" data-lw-open="c-dialog">Delete a sheet</button>
```

#### Menu & tooltip (`data-lw-menu · data-lw-tip`)

Tooltips are supplementary by design. The control itself always carries an accessible name.

```html
<button type="button" class="lw-btn" data-lw-menu="#c-menu">Pad options</button>
<div class="lw-popover lw-menu" id="c-menu" popover>
  <button type="button" class="lw-menu__item"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-keyboard"></use></svg>Set key…</button>
  <button type="button" class="lw-menu__item"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-volume"></use></svg>Volume</button>
  <hr class="lw-menu__sep">
  <button type="button" class="lw-menu__item lw-menu__item--danger"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-trash"></use></svg>Remove pad</button>
</div>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--icon" aria-label="Settings" data-lw-tip="Settings" data-lw-tip-pos="right"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-settings"></use></svg></button>
<button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--icon" aria-label="Copy link" data-lw-tip="Copy link"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-link"></use></svg></button>
```

### Feedback

Short confirmations, quiet empty states, visible waiting. Toasts sit in the bottom centre, above native dialogs, and pause their timer on hover.

#### Toasts (`Linework.toast() · lw-toast-stack`)

```html
<div class="lw-cluster">
  <button type="button" class="lw-btn" data-toast data-toast-title="Added" data-toast-message="North facade is now on the schedule." data-toast-tone="success">Success</button>
  <button type="button" class="lw-btn" data-toast data-toast-title="Settings saved" data-toast-message="The workspace inherits the new paper." data-toast-tone="blue">Info</button>
  <button type="button" class="lw-btn" data-toast data-toast-title="Shortcut taken" data-toast-message="Another app already uses Ctrl+Alt+Backspace." data-toast-tone="warning">Warning</button>
</div>
<p class="demo-note">One live region, maximum four on screen. Each toast pauses when hovered or focused, then resumes.</p>
```

#### Empty state (`.lw-empty`)

```html
<div class="lw-empty" style="width:100%;padding:28px 20px">
  <div class="lw-empty__frame"><span class="lw-title" style="font-size:24px">No sheets yet</span></div>
  <p class="lw-empty__text">Draw a new sheet, or start from a template in the project library.</p>
  <div class="lw-empty__actions"><button type="button" class="lw-btn lw-btn--primary lw-btn--sm" data-lw-open="c-drawer">New sheet</button></div>
</div>
```

### Application

The patterns that make a dashboard read: measured stats, a schedule table, activity, settings rows and an accordion that is just <details> in a good coat.

#### Stats & activity (`.lw-stats · .lw-activity`)

```html
<div class="lw-callout lw-callout--redline"><span class="lw-callout__label">Redline</span><p>Redline marks state: if it is on the sheet, something is live, waiting or at risk.</p></div>
```

### Pickers

Choosing from a list, a date or a number. The combobox, calendar and command palette are Web Components over markup you write; the stepper and chips are classes with a little delegated behaviour.

#### Combobox (`lw-combobox`)

```html
<lw-combobox id="c-combobox">
  <label class="lw-field__label" for="c-lead">Lead</label>
  <input class="lw-input" id="c-lead" type="text" placeholder="Search people">
  <ul class="lw-listbox">
    <li data-value="mara"><span class="lw-option__label">Mara Weiss</span><span class="lw-option__meta">Facade</span></li>
    <li data-value="jonas"><span class="lw-option__label">Jonas Keller</span><span class="lw-option__meta">Interiors</span></li>
    <li data-value="ada"><span class="lw-option__label">Ada Sorensen</span><span class="lw-option__meta">Landscape</span></li>
    <li data-value="omar"><span class="lw-option__label">Omar Haddad</span><span class="lw-option__meta">Facade</span></li>
  </ul>
</lw-combobox>
<p class="lw-smallprint">Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes. Emits <code class="lw-code">lw-change</code> with the value.</p>
```

#### Calendar (`lw-calendar`)

```html
<lw-calendar id="c-calendar" value="2026-10-18" min="2026-10-05" locale="en-GB"></lw-calendar>
```

#### Stepper (`.lw-stepper · data-lw-step`)

```html
<label class="lw-field__label" for="c-seats">Seats</label>
<div class="lw-stepper">
  <button type="button" class="lw-stepper__key" data-lw-step="-1" aria-label="Fewer seats"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-minus"></use></svg></button>
  <input class="lw-input" id="c-seats" type="number" value="4" min="1" max="6" step="1">
  <button type="button" class="lw-stepper__key" data-lw-step="1" aria-label="More seats"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-plus"></use></svg></button>
</div>
```

#### Chips (`.lw-chip · data-lw-dismiss`)

```html
<ul class="lw-chips" id="c-chips" aria-label="Teams on this sheet">
  <li class="lw-chip">Facade<button type="button" class="lw-chip__remove" data-lw-dismiss aria-label="Remove Facade"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-close"></use></svg></button></li>
  <li class="lw-chip">Interiors<button type="button" class="lw-chip__remove" data-lw-dismiss aria-label="Remove Interiors"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-close"></use></svg></button></li>
  <li class="lw-chip">Landscape<button type="button" class="lw-chip__remove" data-lw-dismiss aria-label="Remove Landscape"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-close"></use></svg></button></li>
  <li class="lw-chip">Read only</li>
</ul>
```

#### Command palette (`lw-command`)

```html
<button type="button" class="lw-btn" data-lw-open="c-command"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-search"></use></svg>Open the palette</button>
<span class="lw-smallprint">or press <span class="lw-keycap">Ctrl</span> <span class="lw-keycap">K</span></span>
<lw-command id="c-command" shortcut="k" label="Command palette" placeholder="Search commands and sheets">
  <button type="button" class="lw-command__item" data-group="Sheets" data-shortcut="N">New sheet</button>
  <button type="button" class="lw-command__item" data-group="Sheets">Duplicate North facade</button>
  <button type="button" class="lw-command__item" data-group="Sheets">Archive Roof study</button>

  <a class="lw-command__item" data-group="Go to" href="docs.html">Read the guide</a>
```

### Data & content

A table you can sort, files in flight, a folder tree, a block of code with a copy key and a page banner.

## Class reference

Every `lw-*` class defined in the stylesheet, by source file. `__` marks a part of a component and `--` a variant.

- `accordion.css`: `lw-accordion`, `lw-accordion--boxed`, `lw-accordion--indexed`, `lw-accordion__body`, `lw-accordion__item`, `lw-accordion__summary`
- `base.css`: `lw-between`, `lw-caps`, `lw-cluster`, `lw-code`, `lw-display`, `lw-eyebrow`, `lw-faint`, `lw-fill`, `lw-graph`, `lw-graph--major`, `lw-hairline`, `lw-hatch`, `lw-hatch--paper`, `lw-hatch--pencil`, `lw-heading`, `lw-icon`, `lw-icon--fill`, `lw-label`, `lw-mono`, `lw-muted`, `lw-no-scroll`, `lw-note`, `lw-note--tight`, `lw-nowrap`, `lw-pre`, `lw-prose`, `lw-red`, `lw-row`, `lw-rule`, `lw-scroll-lock`, `lw-scroll-x`, `lw-skip-link`, `lw-smallprint`, `lw-sprite`, `lw-stack`, `lw-stack--loose`, `lw-stack--tight`, `lw-title`, `lw-truncate`, `lw-vh`, `lw-wrap`, `lw-wrap--narrow`

## Design tokens

All custom properties with their values for each theme (`src/css/tokens.css`).

```css
/*
 * Every token is public API: override tokens, not rules.
 * Themes: trace (default), blueprint, vellum. Set data-theme on <html> or any container.
 */

:root {
  color-scheme: light;

  --lw-paper: #eef0ec;
  --lw-paper-lit: #f8f9f6;
  --lw-paper-deep: #e4e7e1;
  --lw-grid: #e6e9e4;
  --lw-grid-major: #e0e4de;
  --lw-rule: #bcc1ba;

  --lw-led-off: #c2c7c0;
  --lw-scrim: rgba(238, 240, 236, 0.82);

  --lw-ink-soft: #343940;
  --lw-pencil: #5e636b;
  --lw-faint: #636a72;

  /* The only colour allowed to mean "live", "playing", "danger". */
  --lw-redline: #c93027;
  --lw-redline-deep: #9e241d;
  --lw-redline-wash: rgba(201, 48, 39, 0.09);
  --lw-on-redline: #f8f9f6;

  /* Information only. Never used for state. */
  --lw-blueprint: #2d4d67;

  --lw-text: var(--lw-ink);
  --lw-text-muted: var(--lw-pencil);
  --lw-text-faint: var(--lw-faint);
  --lw-surface: var(--lw-paper);
  --lw-surface-raised: var(--lw-paper-lit);
  --lw-border: var(--lw-line);

  color-scheme: light;

  --lw-paper: #f2ede2;
  --lw-paper-lit: #faf7ef;
  --lw-paper-deep: #e9e2d3;
  --lw-grid: #e9e3d5;
  --lw-grid-major: #e3dccd;
  --lw-rule: #c8bfac;
  --lw-line: #88837b;
  --lw-led-off: #c7bead;
  --lw-scrim: rgba(242, 237, 226, 0.82);

  --lw-ink: #26221b;
  --lw-ink-soft: #383227;
  --lw-pencil: #5b5346;
  --lw-faint: #6e6557;

  --lw-redline: #c23524;
  --lw-redline-deep: #942618;
  --lw-redline-wash: rgba(194, 53, 36, 0.09);
  --lw-on-redline: #faf7ef;

  --lw-blueprint: #38536b;

  --lw-on-ink: #f2ede2;
  --lw-focus: var(--lw-ink);

/*
 * Semantic aliases have to be recomputed on every theme scope, not just :root.
 * A custom property declared on :root inherits its computed value, so a nested
 * [data-theme="blueprint"] would otherwise keep trace-paper text aliases.
 */
:root,
[data-theme] {
  --lw-text: var(--lw-ink);
  --lw-text-muted: var(--lw-pencil);
  --lw-text-faint: var(--lw-faint);
  --lw-surface: var(--lw-paper);
  --lw-surface-raised: var(--lw-paper-lit);
  --lw-border: var(--lw-line);
  --lw-border-quiet: var(--lw-rule);
  --lw-accent: var(--lw-redline);
  --lw-info: var(--lw-blueprint);
  --lw-danger: var(--lw-redline);
  --lw-focus: var(--lw-ink);

  /* Patterns derive from the local grid colours, so recompute on every scope. */
  --lw-graph-image: linear-gradient(to right, var(--lw-grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--lw-grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
  --lw-graph-size: var(--lw-grid-size) var(--lw-grid-size);
  --lw-graph-major-image: linear-gradient(
      to right,
      var(--lw-grid-major) 1px,
      transparent 1px
    ),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--lw-grid-major) 1px, transparent 1px);
  --lw-graph-major-size: calc(var(--lw-grid-size) * 5) calc(var(--lw-grid-size) * 5);
}

[data-theme] {
  background-color: var(--lw-paper);
  color: var(--lw-text);
}
```

## Types: elements, events and the JavaScript API

```ts
/** Types for the JavaScript API and custom elements. CSS is typed through class names. */

export type LineworkTheme = 'trace' | 'blueprint' | 'vellum';

export type ToastTone = 'default' | 'blue' | 'success' | 'warning';

export interface ToastOptions {
  title?: string;
  message?: string;
  tone?: ToastTone;
  /** Milliseconds before auto-dismiss. Default 4200. */
  duration?: number;
}

export interface ThemeOptions {
  /** Persist the choice to localStorage. Default true. */
  persist?: boolean;
}

export interface IconApi {
  readonly names: string[];
  install(): void;
  /** Returns SVG markup referencing the installed sprite. */
  markup(name: string, className?: string): string;
}

export interface LineworkApi {
  readonly version: string;
  readonly themes: LineworkTheme[];
  getTheme(): LineworkTheme;
  setTheme(name: LineworkTheme | string, options?: ThemeOptions): LineworkTheme;
  cycleTheme(): LineworkTheme;
  toast(options?: ToastOptions | string): HTMLElement | null;
  copy(text: string): Promise<boolean>;
  open(target: string | Element): Element | null;
  close(target: string | Element): Element | null;
  refresh(root?: Document | Element): void;
  formatDuration(seconds: number): string;
  readonly icons: IconApi;
}

export interface LwDrawerElement extends HTMLElement {
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  readonly isOpen: boolean;
  readonly dialog: HTMLDialogElement | null;
}

export interface LwTabsElement extends HTMLElement {
  select(index: number, emit?: boolean): void;
  readonly selectedIndex: number;
}

export interface LwPadElement extends HTMLElement {
  play(seconds?: number): number;
  stop(reason?: string): void;
  toggle(): void;
  setProgress(progress: number, remainingSeconds?: number): void;
  playing: boolean;
  progress: number;
}

export interface LwMeterElement extends HTMLElement {
  level: number;
}

export interface LwComboboxElement extends HTMLElement {
  /** The data-value (or label) of the chosen option, or an empty string. */
  readonly value: string;
}

export interface LwCommandElement extends HTMLElement {
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  readonly isOpen: boolean;
}

export interface LwCalendarElement extends HTMLElement {
  /** Selected date as YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string. */
  value: string;
}

export interface LwToastStackElement extends HTMLElement {
  show(options?: ToastOptions | string): HTMLElement | null;
}

export interface LwDrawerEventDetail {
  drawer?: LwDrawerElement;
}

export interface LwTabsChangeDetail {
  index: number;
  tab: HTMLElement;
  panel: HTMLElement | undefined;
}

export interface LwComboboxChangeDetail {
  value: string;
  option: HTMLElement;
}

export interface LwCalendarChangeDetail {
  value: string;
  date: Date;
}

export interface LwCommandSelectDetail {
  item: HTMLElement;
}

export interface LwSortDetail {
  column: number;
  direction: 'ascending' | 'descending';
}

export interface LwPadEventDetail {
  pad: LwPadElement;
}

export interface LwPadMenuDetail extends LwPadEventDetail {
  anchor: HTMLElement;
}

export interface LwPadPlayDetail extends LwPadEventDetail {
  duration: number;
}

export interface LwPadStopDetail extends LwPadEventDetail {
  reason: string;
}

export declare const Linework: LineworkApi;
export default Linework;

declare global {
  interface Window {
    Linework: LineworkApi;
  }

  interface HTMLElementEventMap {
    'lw-open': CustomEvent<LwDrawerEventDetail | null>;
    'lw-close': CustomEvent<LwDrawerEventDetail>;
    'lw-change': CustomEvent<LwTabsChangeDetail | LwComboboxChangeDetail | LwCalendarChangeDetail>;
    'lw-select': CustomEvent<LwCommandSelectDetail>;
    'lw-sort': CustomEvent<LwSortDetail>;
    'lw-dismiss': CustomEvent<null>;
    'lw-press': CustomEvent<LwPadEventDetail>;
    'lw-menu': CustomEvent<LwPadMenuDetail>;
    'lw-play': CustomEvent<LwPadPlayDetail>;
    'lw-stop': CustomEvent<LwPadStopDetail>;
    'lw-end': CustomEvent<LwPadEventDetail>;
  }

  interface DocumentEventMap {
    'linework:theme': CustomEvent<{ theme: LineworkTheme }>;
    'linework:ready': CustomEvent<{ linework: LineworkApi }>;
  }

  interface HTMLElementTagNameMap {
    'lw-drawer': LwDrawerElement;
    'lw-tabs': LwTabsElement;
    'lw-pad': LwPadElement;
    'lw-meter': LwMeterElement;
    'lw-combobox': LwComboboxElement;
    'lw-command': LwCommandElement;
    'lw-calendar': LwCalendarElement;
    'lw-toast-stack': LwToastStackElement;
  }
}
```

## Types: React wrappers (`linework-ui/react`)

```ts
import type { ForwardRefExoticComponent, HTMLAttributes, ReactNode, RefAttributes } from 'react';
import type {
  LineworkApi,
  LwCalendarChangeDetail,
  LwCalendarElement,
  LwComboboxChangeDetail,
  LwComboboxElement,
  LwCommandElement,
  LwCommandSelectDetail,
  LwDrawerElement,
  LwDrawerEventDetail,
  LwMeterElement,
  LwPadElement,
  LwPadEventDetail,
  LwPadMenuDetail,
  LwPadPlayDetail,
  LwPadStopDetail,
  LwTabsChangeDetail,
  LwTabsElement,
} from './linework.js';

type Base<E extends HTMLElement> = Omit<HTMLAttributes<E>, 'onChange' | 'onSelect' | 'onPlay' | 'onClose' | 'onOpen'> & {
  children?: ReactNode;
};

type Component<P, E extends HTMLElement> = ForwardRefExoticComponent<P & RefAttributes<E>>;

export interface DrawerProps extends Base<LwDrawerElement> {
  open?: boolean;
  label?: string;
  width?: number | string;
  dismissible?: boolean;
  onOpen?: (event: CustomEvent<LwDrawerEventDetail | null>) => void;
  onClose?: (event: CustomEvent<LwDrawerEventDetail>) => void;
}

export interface TabsProps extends Base<LwTabsElement> {
  selected?: number;
  onChange?: (event: CustomEvent<LwTabsChangeDetail>) => void;
}

export interface PadProps extends Omit<Base<LwPadElement>, 'children'> {
  name?: string;
  keys?: string;
  length?: string;
  duration?: number;
  progress?: number;
  playing?: boolean;
  /** true adds the menu key; a string also opens the .lw-menu with that id. */
  menu?: boolean | string;
  onPress?: (event: CustomEvent<LwPadEventDetail>) => void;
  onPlay?: (event: CustomEvent<LwPadPlayDetail>) => void;
  onStop?: (event: CustomEvent<LwPadStopDetail>) => void;
  onEnd?: (event: CustomEvent<LwPadEventDetail>) => void;
  onMenu?: (event: CustomEvent<LwPadMenuDetail>) => void;
}

export interface MeterProps extends Omit<Base<LwMeterElement>, 'children'> {
  level?: number;
  bars?: number;
  live?: boolean;
  tone?: 'redline';
  label?: string;
}

export interface ComboboxProps extends Base<LwComboboxElement> {
  empty?: string;
  onChange?: (event: CustomEvent<LwComboboxChangeDetail>) => void;
}

export interface CommandProps extends Base<LwCommandElement> {
  label?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Key that opens the palette with Ctrl or Cmd, for example "k". */
  shortcut?: string;
  empty?: string;
  onSelect?: (event: CustomEvent<LwCommandSelectDetail>) => void;
}

export interface CalendarProps extends Omit<Base<LwCalendarElement>, 'children'> {
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  value?: string;
  min?: string;
  max?: string;
  locale?: string;
  onChange?: (event: CustomEvent<LwCalendarChangeDetail>) => void;
}

export declare const Drawer: Component<DrawerProps, LwDrawerElement>;
export declare const Tabs: Component<TabsProps, LwTabsElement>;
export declare const Pad: Component<PadProps, LwPadElement>;
export declare const Meter: Component<MeterProps, LwMeterElement>;
export declare const Combobox: Component<ComboboxProps, LwComboboxElement>;
export declare const Command: Component<CommandProps, LwCommandElement>;
export declare const Calendar: Component<CalendarProps, LwCalendarElement>;

export declare const Linework: LineworkApi;
export default Linework;
```

## Blocks

Each block needs `linework-blocks.css` as well as `linework.css`. Layout classes are `blk-*`; everything else is the component API.

### 02 Feature grid (marketing, id `features`)

Six numbered features in a measured grid. Enough room for a real sentence, no card shadows.

```html
<section class="blk blk-features" aria-labelledby="fold-features-title">
  <div class="blk-wrap">
    <div class="blk-head">
      <div>
        <p class="blk-kicker">Features</p>
        <h2 class="blk-title" id="fold-features-title">Everything in plain view.</h2>
        <p class="blk-lede">Six parts of the workspace that replace six other tools. All of them share one surface, one history and one obvious place to look.</p>
      </div>
      <p class="blk-head__aside">Designed for teams of four to four hundred. No hidden panels, no nested menus, no “where did that comment go?”</p>
    </div>
    <div class="blk-features__grid">
      <article class="blk-feature">
        <div class="blk-feature__top"><span class="blk-feature__num">01</span><span class="blk-feature__icon"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-sheet"></use></svg></span></div>
        <h3>Canvas plans</h3>
        <p>Arrange the work spatially. Move a decision and everything it touches moves with it.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="blk-feature">
        <div class="blk-feature__top"><span class="blk-feature__num">02</span><span class="blk-feature__icon"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-file"></use></svg></span></div>

        <p>Specs, notes and approvals live beside the drawing instead of inside a folder nobody opens.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="blk-feature">
        <div class="blk-feature__top"><span class="blk-feature__num">03</span><span class="blk-feature__icon"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-check"></use></svg></span></div>

        <p>Mark up a sheet, not a screenshot. Comments carry the version and the exact point they refer to.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="blk-feature">
        <div class="blk-feature__top"><span class="blk-feature__num">04</span><span class="blk-feature__icon"><svg class="lw-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#lw-i-clock"></use></svg></span></div>

      </article>
```

```html
  </div>
</section>
```

### 04 Questions (marketing, id `faq`)

Questions answered as a drawing schedule, with a human escape hatch on the left.

```html
<section class="blk blk-faq" aria-labelledby="fold-faq-title">
  <div class="blk-wrap">
    <div class="blk-faq__grid">
      <div class="blk-faq__aside">
        <p class="blk-kicker">Questions</p>
        <h2 class="blk-title" id="fold-faq-title">Before you start drawing.</h2>
        <p class="blk-lede blk-lede--sm">If it is not covered here, a person will answer — usually within a working day.</p>
        <div class="blk-faq__contact">
          <span class="lw-avatar lw-avatar--sm">JK</span>
          <span><a href="#">Talk to a human</a><br><span class="lw-smallprint">Jonas, support</span></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="lw-accordion">
        <details class="lw-accordion__item" open>
          <summary class="lw-accordion__summary">Can I invite people who do not have an account?</summary>
          <div class="lw-accordion__body"><p>Yes. Guests can view any sheet you share, leave comments and approve reviews. They only need an account when they want to create sheets of their own.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="lw-accordion__item">
          <summary class="lw-accordion__summary">What happens to a sheet after a project closes?</summary>
          <div class="lw-accordion__body"><p>It moves to the archive with its full revision history, and every link keeps working. You can pin an archived sheet back into an active workspace at any time.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="lw-accordion__item">
          <summary class="lw-accordion__summary">Do you train models on our drawings?</summary>
          <div class="lw-accordion__body"><p>No. Workspace content is never used to train anything. We store it, sync it and return it when asked; nothing else.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="lw-accordion__item">
          <summary class="lw-accordion__summary">Can we use our own type and paper?</summary>
          <div class="lw-accordion__body"><p>Studio and Atelier workspaces can apply a custom paper, ink and redline colour. Every theme is a small set of variables — no rebuild, no plugin.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="lw-accordion__item">
          <summary class="lw-accordion__summary">Is there an offline mode?</summary>
          <div class="lw-accordion__body"><p>Sheets you have opened stay readable offline, and your own notes queue until the connection returns. Review approvals always need a connection so the record stays accurate.</p></div>
        </details>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

### 14 Three steps (marketing, id `process`)

How it works in three numbered steps joined by a dimension rule.

```html
<section class="blk blk-process" aria-labelledby="fold-process-title">
  <div class="blk-wrap">
    <p class="blk-kicker">How it works</p>
    <h2 class="blk-title" id="fold-process-title">From sketch to sign-off.</h2>
    <ol class="blk-process__steps">
      <li class="blk-process__step">
        <span class="blk-process__num">01</span>
        <h3>Pin the drawing</h3>
        <p>Drop a PDF, an image or a model export onto a sheet. Fold keeps every revision.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="blk-process__step">
        <span class="blk-process__num">02</span>
        <h3>Mark it up</h3>
        <p>Reviewers leave redlines where the problem is, not in a thread three tabs away.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="blk-process__step">
        <span class="blk-process__num">03</span>
        <h3>Sign it off</h3>
        <p>Approvals carry a name, a time and the revision they cover. Export the record in one key.</p>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>
```
